jobs.title: Senior Electrical, Instrumentation and Control Engineer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a
  
  

Senior Electrical, Instrumentation and Control Engineer
  
  

to join our Engineering Team in Advario Singapore. The primary work location for this position is Jurong Island.
  
  

**Key Tasks:**  

1\) Automation \& Process control and Instrumentation System Design and Development
  
  

Lead the design, development and implementation of automation systems, including BPCS ( Basic Process and control system, PLC (Programmable Logic Controllers), SCS (Safety Control System ), F\&G SCS ( Fire and Gas Safety Control System ), and other industrial automation technologies
  
  

Evaluate Functional Design Specifications, supervise changes to Integrated Control and Safety System in accordance to Advario technical standards
  
  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand process requirements and develop automation solutions.
  
  

Develop and integrate process control strategies using instrumentation such as sensors, flow computer, batch controller, electric and pneumatic actuators
  
  

Integrate various control systems and instrumentation into the overall automation framework – e.g ICSS ( Integrated Control and Safety System )
  
  

Ensure automation systems and processes comply with industry standards, ADTS regulations and best practices (such as IEC, ISO)
  
  

Work to ensure safety features are incorporated into automation systems, especially in high\-risk environments
  
  

Continuously optimize process performance and automation systems for increased efficiency, reliability, and safety.
  
  

2\) Maintenance and Support
  
  

Provide ongoing support for automation systems, ensuring minimal downtime and swift resolution of any faults or malfunctions
  
  

Prepare and maintain documentation for automation systems, including standard operating procedures and troubleshooting guides
  
  

Analyze system performance data and make recommendations for improvements or upgrades
  
  

3\) Project Management
  
  

Prepare budgets for automation projects, CAPEX and OPEX including tender packages
  
  

Manage schedules, and resources for automation\-related projects
  
  

Lead Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) and/or Hazard \& Operability Studies (HAZOP) for automation projects
  
  

4\) Training and Documentation
  
  

Provide training to plant operators, engineers, and other team members on automation systems and equipment
  
  

Create and update technical documentation, including system diagrams, process flowcharts
  
  

Prepare and maintain documentation for automation systems, including standard operating procedures and troubleshooting guides
  
  

5\) Continuous Improvement
  
  

Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in process automation and instrumentation.
  
  

Suggest and implement new automation tools or techniques to improve process efficiency and reduce costs.
  
  

**Your Profile:**  

Possess at least a Degree in Electrical Engineering
  
  

Has at least 5 years of working experience as an EIC Engineer in the Oil \& Gas / Petrochemical Industry
  
  

Strong knowledge of ICSS, PLC, BPCS, F\&G SCS and SCS system
  
  

Strong knowledge in industrial communication protocols
  
  

Experience with process control algorithms and instrumentation calibration
  
  

Familiarity with automation tools and software (e.g., Siemens, ABB, Honeywell, etc.)
  
  

Proficiency in troubleshooting and problem\-solving automation and electrical systems
  
  

Familiarity with electrical infrastructure and design in industrial environments
  
  

Experience applying ISA\-88 (batch control), ISA\-95 (enterprise integration), OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP
  
  

Knowledge of predictive, preventive, and condition\-based maintenance strategies
  
  

Strong knowledge of ATEX and NFPA requirements in Oil and Gas industry
  
  

Familiarity with project management including contractor and budget management
  
  

Benefits
  
  

Special benefits and company events organized for employees
  
  

Comprehensive group insurance plan, including dependent coverage for hospitalization
  
  

Lunch provided while in the terminal and company shuttle bus transport to and from Jurong East MRT
  
  

Opportunity to work in a multinational company with a strong global presence in the storage and terminal industry
  
  

We are a leading global player in the storage industry, with a focused growth strategy on chemicals, gas and new energy and a strong commitment to embed ESG and sustainability across our entire operations. Advario is a carve\-out of Oiltanking GmbH and we are committed to play a frontrunner role in the energy transition through developing transformational partnerships.
  
  

The storage industry has a key role to play to progress the energy transition and ensure undisrupted, secure access to low carbon energy everywhere in the world. This transition is complex and requires close coordination and cooperation of all partners across the whole value chain. And that is exactly what our strategy is built on. We want to create better business through transformational partnerships. As fossil remains part of energy mix for some time to come, we will continue our services in this sector, but our growth focus therefore our investments dedicated to expanding our business across three segments: chemicals, gas, and increasingly new energies.
  
  

Through putting ESG at the heart of what we do, we achieve better business for our partners, society and ourselves. Besides ambitiously growing our business, we consider it equally important to operate our business highest care and safety standards for our people, the communities we work in and environments we live in. We want to make an impact in two ways. Firstly, by helping our customers reduce their CO2 footprint by enabling their transition to sustainable liquids and secondly by reducing our own emissions. So, we strive for a material share of sustainable revenues and we commit to net\-zero operations by 2040 latest.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Development Managerto lead our software development team in designing, developing, and maintaining high\-quality software applications. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing technical development, mentoring developers, ensuring software quality, and delivering projects on schedule.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of software applications.
  
  

Manage and mentor a team of software developers and programmers.
  
  

Define software architecture and technical standards.
  
  

Review source code and ensure adherence to coding best practices.
  
  

Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and analyze system requirements.
  
  

Develop scalable, secure, and high\-performance applications.
  
  

Troubleshoot complex technical issues and implement effective solutions.
  
  

Coordinate project timelines, task allocation, and resource planning.
  
  

Ensure software quality through testing, code reviews, and documentation.
  
  

Integrate third\-party APIs and enterprise systems where required.
  
  

Monitor system performance and implement continuous improvements.
  
  

Keep up to date with emerging technologies and recommend suitable solutions.
  
  

Prepare technical documentation, user guides, and system specifications.
  
  

Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data protection, and company policies.
  
  

Job Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  

Minimum
  
  

5 years of software development experience
  
  

, including at least
  
  

2 years in a leadership or senior programming role
  
  

.
  
  

Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as
  
  

Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript, PHP, or Go
  
  

.
  
  

Experience with modern frameworks such as
  
  

.NET, Spring Boot, Node.js, React, Angular, or Vue.js
  
  

.
  
  

Knowledge of SQL and database management systems such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle.
  
  

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is an advantage.
  
  

Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices.
  
  

Strong understanding of software architecture, system integration, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
  
  

Experience with Agile or Scrum software development methodologies.
  
  

Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
  
  

Strong communication, leadership, and project management abilities.
  
  

Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  
  

Preferred Skills
  
  

Experience with AI, automation, or machine learning projects is an advantage.
  
  

Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  
  

PMP, Scrum Master, AWS, Azure, or other relevant professional certifications are advantageous.
  
  

Experience leading enterprise software implementation projects.
  
  

Employment Details
  
  

**Position:**  

Software Development Manager
  
  

**Employment Type:**  

Full\-Time
  
  

**Working Location:**  

Singapore
  
  

**Working Hours:**  

Monday to Friday (or as assigned)
  
  

**Salary:**  

Competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience.
  
  

Dear Job Seekers,
  
  

RMR International Pte Ltd Leading Employment Agency will find suitable job to jobseekers.

jobs.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Job Summary
  
  

We are seeking an experienced
  
  

Senior Software Development Engineer
  
  

to design, develop, test, and maintain high\-quality software solutions. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, mentor junior developers, and ensure that software products meet business requirements, performance standards, and security best practices.

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable software applications.
  
  

Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into efficient software solutions.
  
  

Develop high\-quality, secure, and maintainable code following industry best practices.
  
  

Review code, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and optimize application performance.
  
  

Lead system architecture discussions and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks.
  
  

Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, QA engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  

Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior software engineers.
  
  

Perform system integration, debugging, and software maintenance.
  
  

Implement security, data protection, and compliance requirements in software solutions.
  
  

Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  
  

Prepare and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and user guides.
  
  

Research and evaluate emerging technologies to improve development efficiency and product quality.
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  

Minimum
  
  

8 years
  
  

of professional experience in software development.
  
  

Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as
  
  

Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Go
  
  

.
  
  

Experience with modern web frameworks such as
  
  

React, Angular, Vue.js, .NET, Spring Boot, or Node.js
  
  

.
  
  

Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, etc.).
  
  

Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  
  

Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
  
  

Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and object\-oriented programming principles.
  
  

Experience using Git or other version control systems.
  
  

Knowledge of software testing methodologies, including unit, integration, and automated testing.
  
  

Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  
  

Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management abilities.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Professional certifications in cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) are an advantage.
  
  

Experience leading software development teams and delivering enterprise\-scale applications.
  
  

Knowledge of AI, machine learning, data analytics, or cybersecurity is an added advantage.
  
  

Experience working in Agile development environments.
